messages.text: Now let's start the real work. Set the team out, learn how to use IdRes, install it and start working on the first sub-system and layer placement proposals, given the new coverage constraints. Keep the same way of working: make a PR with an executive summary of the proposals, if several proposals are being made, make a 2-pager per proposal underlining strenght and weaknesses of it. Discuss priority list and eventual follow-up questions. Flag items that can not be resolved yet as they'd rely on not yet ready input.

I’ll check the current plan and repository state, then set SysArch, TrackTech, PhysVal and SoftEng to work on the first layout study. I’ll keep the layouts as isolated prototypes, install and exercise IdRes, and prepare a PR with an executive summary, proposal briefs, priorities and unresolved input dependencies.

The first constraint is already clear: at \(|\eta|=4\), a track reaches only about 115 mm radius at the tracker’s far end, so extra large-radius strip disks cannot provide the missing forward measurements. The team is comparing two forward-pixel arrangements while SoftEng builds IdRes. Both will be tested with vertex offsets and field/material variations; the beamspot distribution and complete material budgets remain pending inputs.

The geometry screen finds six ideal measurement stations for A and eight for B in the most demanding forward vertex probe. B uses about 74% more total pixel surface area, with little extra forward radial leverage. Both also have a barrel/endcap region with only three pixel stations. These are crossing results, not tracking-efficiency claims; IdRes will test the corresponding resolution and material trade-offs.

IdRes is installed and running. The independent covariance check caught a multi-field input problem: a combined 2/3/4 T run used the last field for all three cases. SoftEng is rerunning each field separately. The checks also show that the short forward lever arm produces large inverse-momentum uncertainties despite the station counts; the proposals will keep that limitation prominent.

The corrected IdRes runs are complete: all 22 runs produced the expected 729 rows, with no missing fit rows. The near-zero-material results agree with the independent covariance control within the output precision after accounting for IdRes’s rounded magnetic conversion constant. I’m consolidating the results into the two-page briefs; beam pipe, services, module gaps and realistic field maps remain explicit limitations.

Both proposal briefs are now two pages, with layer drawings, strengths, weaknesses and follow-up priorities. The main result is conditional: B adds forward redundancy and modest high-pT precision gains, but worsens the low-pT result under the nominal material assumptions. Independent checks also confirm the reported station counts and material sums. I’m finishing repository checks and preparing the review PR.

[PR #13](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/pull/13) is open with the executive summary and both two-page briefs. A final tracking-record check found a schema error in the review metadata; I’m correcting it and checking CI before handing it over.

Created [PR #13](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/pull/13) with the executive summary, evidence, priorities and two-page briefs:

- **A:** extended ODD layout with narrow forward pixel disks.
- **B:** additional, wider forward pixel disks.

IdRes is installed. We ran **22 configurations with 16,038 complete results**, checked independently.

The key trade-off: B adds 74% more ideal pixel area. At η=4 under nominal assumptions, it modestly improves high-pT precision but worsens low-pT performance. Both proposals retain a pixel-transition weakness; neither is selected.

Priorities are physics/beamspot criteria, aperture and transition checks, then module-aware ACTS studies. Missing component budgets, services, field maps and IdRes public licensing are explicitly flagged.

DES-006, source provenance, dashboard tracking and session records are updated. **Local checks and final CI passed.** Human review remains pending.
